quest.title: A Private Commission
quest.description: Kamisato Ayaka seems to have something to discuss with you. Meet up for a chat with her at Komore Teahouse.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x200, Mora x13925, Adventurer's Experience x6, Mystic Enhancement Ore x3

chapter.title: The Whispers of the Crane and the White Rabbit

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm, where do we go from here...? What's the plan?

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Traveler, Paimon. Hold on.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Ayaka?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's the matter?

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Something has come up, and I would like to request your assistance.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: But you ought not be nervous. This is not coming from the Yashiro Commission or the Kamisato Clan. It is my own individual request.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Individual request? You mean... personal stuff?

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Correct. It concerns my mother.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: This may seem a little sudden... but in my view, you are the only person I can entrust this to.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Can you give me any more details?

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: A few days ago, I was sorting through some old family belongings when I found a notebook that belonged to my mother.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: She wrote about all kinds of things, mostly of little consequence. But what drew my attention was a name — it is one that I have never heard before, so the fact that she mentions it so frequently... it makes it difficult for me to ignore...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Probably your mom's best buddy, right?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You'd really never heard the name before? Not once?

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Never. And although my mother and father passed away many years ago, both my brother and I are familiar with the vast majority of their acquaintances.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: So... I am very curious about this mysterious individual. I would very much like to meet them.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: According to the notebook, their name is "Tsubaki." This seems to have been someone very important to my mother. Someone with a lot of personality, who liked to have fun.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... Paimon thinks it sounds like a girl's name.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: That's what I thought too.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So, what do you want us to do?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Do you need us to find her for you?

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: No, no, her address is given in the notebook — we can head straight there. I wanted you to assist me with the preparation of greeting gifts...

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: ...Please keep everything I have told you in strict confidence.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: The proper course of action would be to involve my brother and visit her together, but he is terribly busy at present, and... on a more selfish note, I don't wish to involve anybody else from Inazuma in this matter.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hence why you came to me, an outlander.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Exactly. That, and you are also a kind, well-mannered person with a genuine concern for other people... not to mention trustworthy. I would not feel comfortable with anyone else in this situation.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You can count on us! We've done greeting gifts before, so we should be able to help. In terms of payment... just treat us to some delicious food, and we'll be more than happy!

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Wonderful — in fact, I was hoping to take this opportunity to show you both around. If you don't mind, of course?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Oh, we don't mind! We don't mind at all! Do we, {NICKNAME}?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Not in the slightest.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Thank you kindly! Shall we head off, then? Ogura Textiles & Kimonos is our first stop.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright! Sounds great!
